# Companion Scan

> Companion Scan is a web app for iPhone and Android that captures a 3D map of a room with your phone's camera. Scans are saved in your browser and sent to a Companion Scan server you run, such as a Companion Hub.

Companion Scan is part of the Companion Intelligence platform (https://ci.computer/). It installs to the home screen as a web app. AR capture needs a phone with a camera; the 3D viewer and the server also run on a computer. The docs cover installing it from the Companion Hub App Store, setup and where scans are stored.

## Pages

- [Companion Scan](https://scan.ci.computer/): the scanner app
- [Companion Scan docs](https://docs.ci.computer/docs/apps-available/first-party-apps/spatial-scan): install from the Companion Hub App Store (beta), setup and storage
